jobs.occupation: 🌾 ROSKILDE: THATCHERS WANTED – A BAD HAIR DAY IS ACTUALLY PART OF THE JOB
jobs.description:
🌾 ROSKILDE: THATCHERS WANTED – A BAD HAIR DAY IS ACTUALLY PART OF THE JOB

Straw in your hair.

Straw on your clothes.

Straw in places you didn’t even know straw could get into.

But at the end of the day, you’ll have a thatched roof you can look at and be proud of.

We are looking for several skilled thatchers to work on thatched roofs in and around Roskilde.

🏠 A CRAFT YOU CAN ACTUALLY SEE

Your working day will revolve around thatching and thatched roofs.

You’ll work on a variety of tasks within the trade, where craftsmanship, precision and attention to the finished result really matter.

Because there’s one slightly unforgiving thing about a thatched roof:

It’s pretty difficult to hide a poor finish behind a sheet of plasterboard.

👷 WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

There are two ways you could be a good fit:

🎓 You have relevant training or qualifications

or

🔨 You have hands-on experience with thatching.

The important thing is that you know the trade and are able to contribute from day one.

In addition:

✔ A Category B driving licence is required
✔ A BE driving licence is a plus
✔ You can work independently
✔ You take pride and responsibility in your craftsmanship
✔ You have an eye for quality and a good finish
✔ You’re comfortable with your workplace being a little higher up than the car park

🚐 A COMPANY VEHICLE CAN BE PROVIDED

So there’s no need to turn your own car into a combination of toolbox, storage unit and hay bale.

If you want to work in a trade where quality craftsmanship is still done by hand – and can be admired from a distance, we’d like to hear from you.

And no...

You don’t have to enjoy finding straw in your socks. That part just comes with the job.

📞 +45 49 90 21 38
✉️ nicklas@entreprisegruppen.com

Join a project that’s not just exciting—it’s world-changing! We’re looking for talented individuals to be part of something truly remarkable. If you’re driven by challenge and the chance to make a lasting impact, this is the perfect place for you. Don’t just be a part of the future—help create it.

About FLC:

At Femern Link Contractors (FLC), we are responsible for designing and constructing the immersed tunnel, portals, and ramps on both ends of the tunnel, in Rødbyhavn and Puttgarden.

We are also building the facilities for prefabricating tunnel elements as well as accommodation facilities, also known as the “Tunnel village” in Rødbyhavn, which provides housing for FLC workers.

About the department:

The immersion engineering team is looking for a Deputy Lead Immersion Engineer to strengthen the team. Immersion engineering is taking care of all calculations regarding tunnel elements float up (weight analysis, determine ballast concrete and water, longitudinal section forces, floating stability), transfers in basins and harbour (winch operations with or without vessel assistance), mooring of the tunnel elements, transport to offshore location, immersion (including but not limited to dynamic analyses) and the stability of the elements after immersion.

As the Deputy Lead Immersion Engineer, you will coordinate and participate in the team responsible for floating up and/or hoisting the concrete tunnel elements, equipping them in the port and then transporting and installing them at sea. In a first phase you will participate in the preparation of this crucial operation, by making ballast plans e.g.. In a second phase, you will be part of the operational team that does the immersion work, by going offshore and assist the Immersion Master by giving technical advice. This is what you are prepared to do in Denmark (full time or in 4-2 rotation).

Main tasks and responsibilities:

• As Deputy Lead Immersion Engineer, you will focus on coordination of the tasks for the team and manage the stakeholders

• During the preparatory phase, you are responsible for the ballast plans and float up calculations.

• You take part in the interface management with other departments within FLC regarding specific parts of the T&I scope

• You will coordinate part of the design scope between Work Preparations and the design team based in the Netherlands and Belgium

• You are involved in the management/operation of Tunnel Control Systems

• You ensure the conclusions and results from the design documents are correctly taken over in the work method statements, drawings and operation manuals for the Immersion Pontoon specific operations related to the overall transport and immersion scope

• You liaise with the Marine Warranty Surveyor and contribute to the work procedures, Go/No Go procedures

• During float up and ballasting you check if operations stay within boundary conditions and act accordingly

• During the execution phase, you advise during the transport and installation of the elements. You will be present in the command unit of the immersion pontoons during offshore operations. You will do checks during execution, monitor the immersion process, and have an advisory role to the one in charge of the operation. You are also prepared and ready to deal with contingencies if any might occur

• After immersion, you will organize and do checks on data to create lessons learned for next operations

Qualifications:

• You are a qualified naval architect/maritime engineer/offshore engineer with minimum of 7 years experience

• You have prior experience with immersion of large structures or offshore lifting operations

• You have a good understanding of stability calculations, mooring calculations and hydrodynamics

• You are a hands-on problem solver and a decision maker

• You are a team player with strong communication skills

• You find it a challenge to work in a international, multi-cultural work-environment in which communication and team spirit is key to success

• You are fluent in English.

Conditions: 

FLC considers transparent management structures, short decision-making channels, and a team-oriented environment to be extremely important. The FLC staff is expected to set themselves targets, achieve them independently, and take responsibility for their actions – irrespective of their position in the company.

Full time employment with health insurance and lunch arrangement available upon request.

Workplace:

Based in Rødbyhavn.

Application:

We look forward to receiving your application (in English) as soon as possible and. Applications received will be processed on an ongoing basis, and we will complete the recruitment once we have found the right profile.

jobs.description:

VP Sales Europe

Based out of Teton’s headquarters in Copenhagen, Denmark.

About Teton

Teton is building the foundational data layer for the point of care, using real-time, multimodal AI to generate a digital twin of the patient and care environment. Our product alleviates administrative inefficiencies and observational tasks that overburden healthcare professionals, enabling them to provide better patient care.

Through a combination of in-room hardware, AI, and desktop and mobile applications, Teton helps create a seamless healthcare experience for both patients and providers. Our solution provides unprecedented access to real-time data insights, creating a digital twin of resident states and care delivery that empowers healthcare providers with actionable intelligence for optimal decision-making.

With strong demand and clear product-market fit, Teton is focused on scaling its presence across Europe. We operate through a Country Director model across three established territories - the Nordics (Copenhagen), UK&I (London), and the DACH region (Zurich) - selling into both public hospital systems and care home operators. This is a rare opportunity to lead an established multi-country commercial organisation, bring consistency and governance across territories, and open Teton’s next European markets.

Key Responsibilities

• 
Lead, coach, and develop Teton’s European sales organisation in the Nordics, UK&I, and DACH, holding each territory accountable to its new business targets.

• 
Own and optimise Teton’s European commercial operating cadence across pipeline generation, tender and bid qualification, deal progression, forecasting, CRM governance, performance management, and team accountability - creating a consistent governance structure across territories while respecting local market differences.

• 
Act as a hands-on deal leader on Europe's largest opportunities, across both public tenders and complex private enterprise deals - joining critical customer meetings, site visits, and executive presentations to bring deals over the line.

• 
Optimise go-to-market in each territory: segmentation, coverage model, territory design, resourcing, and partner strategy across public hospital systems and private and public care home operators.

• 
Evaluate and open new core European markets, such as the Benelux region - building the market-entry case, the operating model, and the initial commercial footprint.

• 
Recruit, onboard, and develop commercial leadership and talent as Europe scales, while raising the effectiveness of the existing teams.

• 
Represent Teton at major European industry conferences, national associations, while helping refine go-to-market strategy, messaging, pricing, and commercial execution across the region.

What We’re Looking For

• 
Significant experience selling and leading teams that sell large and complex contracts won through public sector tenders and RFPs - a genuine command of the public procurement motion is essential for this role.

• 
Equivalent enterprise experience closing large, complex contracts with private organisations, as both motions exist across Teton’s European territories.

• 
A demonstrated track record as a highly successful individual contributor, consistently exceeding significant new business quotas and closing complex, high six-figure ACV opportunities across long sales cycles.

• 
Proven sales leadership experience managing, coaching, and developing sales leaders and net-new business teams carrying significant new business quotas, ideally across multiple European countries or territories.

• 
The ability to operate as a true player-coach: strategic enough to optimise the sales organisation and operating model, but hands-on enough to actively influence and close critical deals.

• 
Deep experience managing long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles involving executive buyers, procurement, legal, and ownership groups.

• 
A rigorous, data-driven approach to pipeline management, forecasting, CRM accuracy, qualification, performance management, and sales governance.

• 
Experience building or scaling sales teams, segmentation models, territories, processes, methodologies, and repeatable go-to-market motions, including entering new markets.

• 
Exposure to healthcare, hospital systems or senior living is a strong bonus, but not a requirement.

• 
12+ years in enterprise sales, with at least 5 of those spent leading sales teams.

• 
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience, with a willingness to travel regularly across Europe.

What We Offer

• 
Competitive salary and participation in our warrant program.

• 
Work with state-of-the-art technology in a pioneering field.

• 
A high-impact leadership position with significant influence over Teton’s European go-to-market strategy, territory structure, and commercial execution.

• 
A vibrant, learning-focused work environment

We are looking for a Domain Architect to join our Business Engagement and Platform Solutions team, where you will take domain ownership of the application and platform architecture and drive alignment across our architecture practices.

About the job

The role combines architectural ownership with close business engagement. You will define and maintain the target architecture for applications and platforms, contribute to solution design together with our solution architects and delivery teams, and act as a trusted architectural advisor to the business areas you support.

Your key responsibilities

• Take domain ownership of Orifarm's application and platform architecture, including current state, target state and the roadmap between them

• Engage closely with business stakeholders to understand their processes, priorities and ambitions, and translate these into application and platform solutions

• Drive the architecture forum by setting the agenda, preparing decisions and ensuring alignment across the solution, data, integration and infrastructure architecture practices

• Support solution architects and delivery teams through design reviews, architectural guidance and joint solution design

• Develop and maintain reference architectures, design patterns and architectural standards for the application and platform domain

• Drive simplification of the application portfolio through consolidation, lifecycle management and modernization of key applications

• Support the evaluation, selection and integration of new applications and platforms, ensuring that they can be operated and maintained sustainably

Who are you?

We are looking for a pragmatic and business-oriented architect who is comfortable moving between technical design and stakeholder dialogue. You communicate clearly, and you create alignment through collaboration and professional credibility.

We imagine your profile includes:

• +5 years of experience within solution, application or platform architecture, or a background as a senior developer, lead engineer with relevant architectural experience

• Demonstrated ability to translate business requirements into concrete application and platform solutions

• Good understanding of cloud platforms, preferably Microsoft Azure, as well as ERP ecosystems and modern integration patterns

• Experience facilitating architectural decisions across teams and disciplines, for example through design reviews or architecture forums

• Experience from a regulated industry such as pharmaceuticals, life science or medical devices is an advantage

• Knowledge of architecture frameworks is an advantage, with emphasis on practical application rather than formal certification

• Professional proficiency in English. Danish or German is an advantage

Who are we?

You will be part of Business Engagement & Platform Solutions, a function of approximately 40 colleagues across three business-aligned solution teams as well as architecture and integration practices with direct reference to the VP of Corporate IT. Moreover, you will join an organization where IT plays a central role in enabling the business strategy, driving commercial outcomes.

The role offers clear ownership of an architecture domain, close cooperation with senior business stakeholders, and the opportunity to help shape our architecture practice as our organization scales.

Why should you join Orifarm?

At Orifarm, we are united by a shared purpose: improving access to affordable medicine for the people who need it. Founded in Odense in 1994 by Birgitte & Hans Bøgh-Sørensen, we have built our business on challenging conventional thinking to make affordable high-quality pharmaceuticals more accessible across Europe. Rather than developing new medicines, we focus on finding smarter ways to bring existing treatments to patients, creating value for pharmacies, healthcare systems, and society.

We live by the mindset Challenge Accepted. It reflects our explorer spirit and can-do attitude, where challenges are perceived as opportunities. We encourage people to ask questions, challenge assumptions, and take ownership. Across teams, functions, and markets, you will find a collaborative and supportive culture built on trust, respect, and a flat hierarchy where everyone has a voice and direct access to decision-makers.

When you join Orifarm, you will be empowered to make a real impact from day one. We offer autonomy and great opportunities for career advancement, enabling our employees to shape their professional development. We value flexibility and provide a hybrid work model with the possibility of working from home two days a week.

We invite you to join Orifarm, if you are curious, ambitious, and accept the challenge of bringing better deals of medicine to millions.

We encourage everyone to apply

At Orifarm, we welcome people from all backgrounds, recognizing that the best outcomes come from a diverse and inclusive work environment. Our commitment is to create an environment where different perspectives and skills drive innovation and contribute to a sustainable future. By creating such an environment, we are confident that we can achieve better results together.

jobs.occupation: Portfolio & Capacity Manager for Systematic's Group IT Strategy
jobs.description:
Portfolio & Capacity Manager for Systematic's Group IT Strategy

Can you bring clarity and control to a fast-moving portfolio, making capacity visible, commitments realistic, and decisions easier to steer?

The job

Group IT (GRIT) is Systematic's internal IT function. It supports all business units with infrastructure, systems, integrations, and governance. As Portfolio & Capacity Manager, you will keep our IT portfolio governed, visible, and deliverable, and give the organisation a clear picture of whether commitments match available capacity.

This role sits close to the top of the organisation. The portfolio and capacity overview you maintain is used directly by our CIO and senior leadership to decide what Systematic takes on next, and what is delayed. The accuracy of your work has a direct bearing on the quality of those decisions.

Some of your key responsibilities will be to:

• Own the live overview of who is working on what and how much capacity is available, by collecting, validating, and maintaining data in Excel, Power BI, or similar tools

• Assess new project requests together with the Enterprise Architect and the Director, so we understand what committing to new work would mean for the portfolio

• Onboard new project managers into our governance model, help them get started properly, and keep documentation consistent across the portfolio

• Support the handover of projects from planning into delivery and operation, so nothing crosses over undocumented

• Prepare decision-ready material for the steering committee, run the meeting cadence, and follow up on decisions and actions

Joining the team

The portfolio machinery you will operate is still being created, and you will help shape it. Our ambition is to mature the portfolio into a transparent and trusted view of what is underway, what will be delivered and when, and the value it creates. This will enable clearer communication with the business, while strengthening follow-through within IT and ensuring that capacity is aligned with demand so commitments can be delivered efficiently and to a high standard.

You will become part of the GRIT Strategy team, a small group where specialists and project managers work closely together to keep our internal strategy on track. Reporting to the Director of Group IT Strategy, you will take over a running portfolio process from an interim consultant and work closely with project managers, the Enterprise Architect, and GRIT leadership.

The team is based in Aarhus. If you are located in Copenhagen, we are open to discussing a hybrid arrangement, but you should expect regular presence in Aarhus (6–8 days per month).

Your qualifications

The most important thing you bring is solid experience from an IT portfolio office - where you have supported IT project delivery, system implementations, IT operations - combined with strong analytical skills and hands-on experience with Excel and Power BI, or similar tools, to build and maintain reliable overviews (experience with Jira is an advantage). Additionally, we expect that you have:

• A good understanding of project management and agile ways of working

• Strong communication skills and the ability to present clearly to senior stakeholders

• Comfort exploring AI tools, like Claude, to work smarter and improve how we report and prioritise

• Fluent English; Danish is an advantage

Personally, you enjoy diligent, hands-on work and take pride in keeping information complete, consistent, and current. You are comfortable following up with stakeholders when inputs are missing or unclear, and you thrive as a senior specialist who takes ownership of your domain and leads through sound judgement, structure, and attention to detail.

Please note that you must be able to present a clean criminal record and have lived in a NATO and/or an EU country for the past seven years as we work with security-classified projects.

Welcome to Systematic Aarhus

At our Aarhus office, you can look forward to joining our Employees Club, which offers nearly 100 events a year of both social and professional character. Here, you can take advantage of a range of on-site perks from physiotherapist-led massages and an in-house hairdresser to sports clubs, game tables, and even our own padel court. Our canteen is a standout feature, serving a daily selection of delicious and healthy dishes. Beyond the office, you will also enjoy benefits like free ARoS +1 access and various shopping discounts.

Never stop developing

Systematic is uniquely people-centric, truly international and proudly rooted in Denmark with more than 1,100 employees. Together, we write intelligent and innovative code to drive progress and improve lives. We develop IT solutions that make a real difference where it matters most. This is why we never stop developing. Here, there is room to be professional and personal. It is not just a place to work but a place to belong.

Start your development here

We will be assessing applications on an ongoing basis as we wish to welcome our new colleague as soon as possible, so click Apply Now and send us your CV today. If you have any questions, you are always welcome to contact us on tel. +45 8943 2000 and ask for Nanna Holmann Opstrup, Director of Group IT Strategy.

jobs.occupation: Are you at your best when others are winding down? Join NORMAL's evening team in Hedensted
jobs.description:
A busy warehouse doesn't stop when the afternoon ends and neither does the team at NORMAL's warehouse in Hedensted.

We are looking for reliable and motivated warehouse employees who want to become part of the evening shift.

This job is for you if you enjoy an active workday, like having clear goals and take pride in delivering a stable performance – shift after shift.

You will become part of a team where everyone has an important role. We depend on each other, which means reliability, responsibility and a positive attitude really matter.

What will you be doing?

Your main tasks will include:

• Picking and packing goods using a handheld scanner

• Handling and moving goods throughout the warehouse

• Operating a runner – previous experience is a strong advantage

• Maintaining an efficient and consistent work pace

• Helping your team achieve the evening's targets

The work is physical and the pace is high, so you should enjoy an active job where you are on the move.

What makes a great NORMAL warehouse employee?

It's not only about being fast.

It's about being consistent.

We are looking for colleagues who:

• Show up reliably and are ready to work

• Deliver a stable effort throughout the entire shift

• Are flexible when tasks and priorities change

• Take responsibility for their own work

• Understand and respect performance expectations

• Can receive feedback professionally and use it to improve

• Work efficiently without compromising quality

• Support their colleagues and contribute to the team

Previous warehouse experience, especially within picking and packing, is preferred. Experience operating a runner or similar warehouse equipment is a significant advantage.

You will always know what is expected

NORMAL's warehouse works with clear picking targets and performance expectations.

Productivity and work pace are followed throughout the shift. This creates transparency: you know what is expected, how you are performing and where you can improve.

For the right person, that's motivating.

We expect you to take feedback seriously, take ownership of your performance and work towards delivering consistent results.

In return, you get a workplace with clear expectations and the opportunity to show what you can do.

Your working hours – Evening Shift

Monday – Thursday: 15:00 – 23:00

Friday: 14:30 – 22:00

Your shift includes a 20-minute paid break and a 30-minute unpaid break.

What do we offer?

• DKK 173.60 per hour

• Holiday pay, pension and optional-choice account (Fritvalg)

• Employment according to applicable collective agreements

• An active job where no two shifts feel slow

• Clear goals and ongoing feedback

• Great colleagues and strong teamwork

• Experience from a large and growing company

• Possibility of long-term employment for candidates who consistently perform well

Ready to become part of the evening team?

If you're the person your colleagues can rely on – someone who shows up, stays engaged, takes responsibility and delivers a consistent effort – we want to hear from you.

Apply today and show us what you can bring to the team.

Your main tasks will include:

• Handling and moving goods throughout the warehouse

• Operating a runner – previous experience is a strong advantage

• Keeping a steady and efficient work pace

• Working together with your colleagues to reach the team's daily goals

This is an active job, so you should enjoy being on the move throughout your shift.

Who are we looking for?

For us, the right attitude is just as important as speed.

We are looking for someone who:

• Is reliable and stable – your team can count on you

• Is flexible and ready to contribute where needed

• Takes responsibility for their own tasks and performance

• Understands that clear targets are part of the job

• Can maintain a consistent performance throughout the day

• Is open to feedback and uses it to improve

• Works efficiently while maintaining quality

• Contributes positively to the team

Previous warehouse experience, particularly within picking and packing, is preferred. Experience operating a runner or similar warehouse equipment is a significant advantage.

Clear expectations – from day one

At NORMAL, performance matters.

The warehouse works with clear picking targets and performance expectations, and productivity is followed throughout the working day.

That means you should be comfortable knowing what is expected of you and motivated by reaching your targets consistently.

You don't have to be perfect on your first day. But we expect you to be engaged, listen to feedback, take responsibility for your development and work towards becoming a strong and stable member of the team.

Your working hours – Day Shift

Monday – Thursday: 07:00 – 15:00

Friday: 07:00 – 14:30

Your shift includes a 20-minute paid break and a 30-minute unpaid break.

What do we offer?

• DKK 173.60 per hour

• Holiday pay, pension and optional-choice account (Fritvalg)

• Employment according to applicable collective agreements

• An active workday where the time moves quickly

• Clear expectations and feedback on your performance

• Good colleagues and a strong team environment

• Experience from a large and growing company

• Possibility of long-term employment for candidates who perform well and are a good match

Does this sound like you?

You show up. You take responsibility. You keep your pace. You listen to feedback. And you want to be part of a team where everyone is expected to contribute.

Then we would like to hear from you.

Apply today – interviews are held on an ongoing basis.

Working through JKS

Magnus Jónhardsson

Magnus Jónhardsson

Developing great products for sports applications in a highly technical and dynamic environment?

Join us on our journey to enable athletes around the world with actionable, data-driven insights. Trackman is expanding with an additional Project Lead to lead the development of our next-generation modular hardware platform designed to serve multiple sports applications, from idea generation through production and into the field. Being a Hardware Project Lead at Trackman requires you to work closely together with several senior stakeholders in a very dynamic environment – driven by our passion for the product, the customer and sports.

The position is in the R&D Hardware department, working closely with all hardware teams – mechanics, optics, electronics, and certification – as well as our close colleagues in embedded software, tracking algorithm teams, supply chain, manufacturing engineering, and production.

The workplace for this position is at our HQ in Science Park DTU in Hørsholm.

Your key responsibilities are

• 
Lead the hardware project group together with the Product Owner(s), developing next-generation hardware for golf and other sports applications.

• 
Translate customer and business needs into clear technical requirements and hardware architecture.

• 
Collaborate with stakeholders across Management, Business Development, Tracking, and Manufacturing to align priorities and ensure progress.

• 
Turn technical requirements into actionable tasks, manage resources and dependencies, and maintain the overall hardware project plan.

• 
Represent Trackman in technical discussions with suppliers, including specifications, quality issues, and expectations.

• 
Communicate project status, progress, risks, and key obstacles clearly to management and other stakeholders.

• 
Coordinate international product certifications, including CE, FCC, and UL, together with the Certification team.

• 
Identify and manage hardware risks related to areas such as product quality, obsolescence, suppliers, and certifications.

Job requirements

Are you our new colleague?

We’re looking for an experienced project manager with a strong hardware engineering background who can bridge technical complexity, business needs, and collaboration. Ideally, you bring:

• 
Several years of project management experience in hardware product development, preferably with RF systems.

• 
Experience with complex projects across mechanics, electronics, RF, and embedded software.

• 
Strong understanding of requirements management, design verification, and product industrialization.

• 
Solid business acumen and the ability to translate diverse user needs into robust product solutions.

• 
Experience with project management methodologies and Agile principles, ideally bringing complex electronics products to market.

• 
Strong communication skills and a collaborative approach, knowing when to listen, challenge, and take the lead.

Who is Trackman

Trackman is a privately-owned company founded in 2003. The company has experienced consistent high growth driven by a market-leading sports ball tracking technology based on radar and vision tracking, sustained by a strong desire to innovate.

The company employs globally more than 1000+ employees and has offices in Denmark (headquarter in Hørsholm), Aarhus, US (Connecticut and Arizona), Japan, South Korea, and Poland.

While being active in multiple sports including baseball, football, and soccer, Trackman is first and foremost a golf company. Trackman has revolutionised the way golf players train and instructors teach, and is now broadening the technology so all golfers can take advantage – whether they are playing indoors, on driving ranges, or on the golf course.

In baseball, Trackman is the leading technology company in the world with solutions for practice, games, and the largest data sharing network, monetised by selling draft data on amateur players to the Major League Baseball teams. Trackman has also developed practice solutions for American Football and Soccer that are now used among top teams.

Trackman has the largest R&D capacity in the industry and is constantly aiming to push the boundaries for sports, technology, and data. We strive to recruit the best talent from around the world for R&D functions such as Hardware. At our HQ in Denmark, we have an R&D team of more than 250 FTEs representing more than 40 countries around the world. Trackman designs, develops, and produces all of our technology from start to finish in-house under one roof.

Trackman’s 12,500 m² state-of-the-art CO₂-neutral headquarter is located in Science Park DTU in Hørsholm.

The Office

We are located at DTU Science Park in Hørsholm. We take great pride in the state-of-art building we have designed! The office features bright meeting rooms, coffee areas to catch up with colleagues, a large testing arena with simulators available for employees and a fitness center, everything surrounded by a beautiful forest and respecting the environment. We made sure to utilize the newest technologies to be energy efficient and be mindful of ventilation and sound propagation. The cherry on top is our canteen: with an indoor and outdoor area to enjoy the fresh food prepared by our own kitchen staff.

Join the home of a powerful sports brand and a one-of-a-kind technology

Our proprietary technology is based on expert knowledge about radar, computer vision, data, and software engineering. Our solutions are developed by specialists who endlessly explore and challenge new technical boundaries. Trackman’s blend of cutting-edge technology, sports, and continued growth make our company an outstanding place to work.

Our work culture is entrepreneurial, ambitious, and rewarding as you get to collaborate with inspiring colleagues and interact with the leaders of golf, baseball, and football. Based on a unique brand reputation, we are proud to work in close partnership with the top athletes, organizations, and teams that rely on our technology to stay ahead of the race.

We are a Danish company founded, owned, and managed since 2003 by three entrepreneurs with a strong passion for sports. Today, we have a global footprint with our headquarters located in Denmark (Hørsholm) and offices in New York, Phoenix, Seoul and Tokyo. We employ over 1000+ people worldwide, half of which work in Denmark, where most hardware and software products are developed, tested, and manufactured.

Where innovation happens

At Trackman, we know that great people make great products. We believe that teams thrive, and innovation sparks in an atmosphere where people are encouraged to think for themselves, where everybody’s voices are heard, and where the best ideas prevail in the pursuit of exceptional solutions. This mix makes Trackman an inspiring company – for our customers and colleagues.

Share our Passion!

At Paychex Europe, we simplify payroll, HR and workforce management for businesses across Europe. We believe great results come from people who take ownership, share knowledge, challenge the status quo and treat colleagues and customers with honesty and respect. When you join our team, you can make a mark by helping us deliver solutions that make work easier for businesses and their employees.

Student Assistant – Online Marketing

Support our online marketing team across Denmark and Germany with hands-on execution in SEO, social media, paid campaigns, and reporting.

Paychex Europe is growing its digital presence across two markets, and our online marketing team is looking for an extra pair of skilled hands to help keep momentum. As our markets evolve and content demands increase, we need someone who can hit the ground running on execution.

As our Student Assistant in Online Marketing, you will work closely with our online and field marketing as well as product marketing teams. You will own recurring tasks across SEO, social media, campaign support, and competitor monitoring - and you will see the direct impact of your work on our digital channels. This is a role with real responsibility, not just support work, and a great opportunity to build hands-on B2B marketing experience across two European markets.

About our products

Paychex Europe offers a full suite of HR, payroll and workforce management solutions for businesses in Denmark and Germany – including Lessor Payroll, Emply People, Danløn, and Paychex Europe Payroll. Our customers range from small businesses to mid-sized enterprises, and our marketing helps them discover how we can make their work easier.

What you will do

You will support our online marketing team across Denmark and Germany with execution across four key areas. You will take ownership of recurring tasks and contribute directly to our digital performance. Your responsibilities will include:

• SEO & content

• Review and improve SEO elements across our website: meta titles, H1s, internal links, and image alt texts

• Audit our content for language coverage gaps between the Danish and German versions of the site and flag priorities to the team

• Social media

• Maintain and execute the content calendar for LinkedIn and Meta across both markets

• Produce social assets in Canva and/or Photoshop for organic posts and paid campaigns

• Publish approved content on schedule and monitor engagement

• Paid & website support

• Write ad copy variations and landing page headlines for A/B testing

• Produce visual assets for paid campaigns, including banners and ad creatives

• Reporting & competitor monitoring

• Compile a weekly performance snapshot across organic and social channels

• Run a regular competitor scan and support monthly reporting for the DK and DE markets

What will help you succeed

We encourage you to apply even if you don't tick every single box. The following experience and skills will help you succeed in this role:

• Currently enrolled in a bachelor's or master's programme in marketing, digital media, communications, or similar

• Comfortable writing in English; fluent Danish is required, German is a strong plus

• Detail-oriented with a sharp eye for copy, consistency, and structure

• Fast at execution and not afraid to try new things

• Self-driven and reliable - you manage your own time and deliver on time

• Some familiarity with tools like Canva, Adobe Photoshop, Google Analytics, or LinkedIn — we'll teach the rest

What we offer

• Real responsibility from day one, not just support tasks

• Broad exposure to B2B digital marketing: SEO, paid media, social, and reporting

• A senior team that takes your development seriously

• Flexible hours built around your study schedule

Start date: As soon as possible

Location: Allerød (hybrid)

Hours: 15 hours per week

We value different perspectives and believe diverse teams make better decisions. If this role interests you and you can see yourself contributing to our team, we encourage you to apply!

For questions about the role, please do not hesitate to contact Edyta Tomaszewska etomaszewska@paychex.eu. Applications are reviewed continuously, and we look forward to meeting candidates who are excited about this opportunity.

Join Saxo’s Enterprise Identity & Data Security (EIDS) team and play a pivotal role in protecting the bank’s most valuable asset it’s data.

About the role

In this role, you will design and implement advanced data protection controls across modern security platforms, with a strong focus on Microsoft Purview and insider risk solutions. You will translate complex regulatory and data risk requirements into scalable, effective technical controls that safeguard sensitive information and strengthen Saxo’s security posture.

This is a unique opportunity to contribute to Saxo’s broader agenda around security, governance, and operational resilience within a highly regulated financial environment, working closely with stakeholders across technology, compliance, and the business.

Your responsibilities

As a Senior Data Security Engineer, you will:

• Design and implement data protection controls across Microsoft Purview (DLP, Information Protection, Insider Risk Management)

• Translate data security risks and regulatory requirements into robust, enforceable technical solutions

• Lead and support the rollout and optimisation of Insider Risk Management and user activity monitoring tools (e.g. Teramind)

• Drive data discovery, classification, and visibility across structured and unstructured data environments

• Monitor, tune, and continuously improve the effectiveness of data protection policies and controls

• Collaborate with security, compliance, and business stakeholders to mitigate data risks and strengthen governance frameworks

Your profile

We are looking for a proactive and technically strong professional who can balance risk, regulation, and real-world implementation:

• 7–10 years of experience in data security or information security engineering

• Hands-on expertise with Microsoft Purview (DLP, labelling, Insider Risk)

• Strong understanding of data protection risks, insider threats, and mitigation strategies

• Experience working in regulated environments (financial services is an advantage)

• Solid knowledge of Microsoft 365, Azure, and enterprise security tooling

• Experience with automation or scripting (e.g. PowerShell, APIs) is a plus

• Relevant certifications such as SC-400 are preferred

We get curious people invested in the world

When you work at Saxo, you become a Saxonian and part of a purpose-driven organisation, where good ideas are always taken seriously, and where you can make a true impact. We are invested in your development, and you can expect a robust career from day one when you join Saxo – no matter which role you take on.

You will join 2,500 other ambitious colleagues across 11 countries and become part of an international organisation. Working in Saxo, you will get to meet colleagues from many different cultures and backgrounds, and you should know that we value diversity and inclusion and see it as a genuine source of strength to drive growth, foster innovation and position us for long-term success.

We encourage an open feedback culture and supportive team environments enabling employees to grow and fulfil their career aspirations.

When you bring passion, curiosity, drive and team spirit, your learning journey will be dynamic and your career opportunities in Saxo will be immense.

At Saxo we don’t just offer a job – we offer an opportunity to invest in your future!

Do you want to create real impact by identifying key cost and value drivers? Do you want to become a part of an international company that contributes to the green transition?

Here is what the job entails

As our student worker in Controlling, you will play a key role in supporting our Finance Business Partnering team by handling data, conducting analysis, and collaborating with stakeholders to solve business challenges. You will be ensuring timely and high-quality execution of tasks, while contributing to process improvements through data modelling. Furthermore, you will be assisting with various tasks such as creating instructions as well as supporting team members during peak loads.

More specifically, you will be:

• Ensuring accuracy and quality in resource allocation data

• Keeping Project data up to date, including control of capitalization on projects

• Supporting the maintenance and reporting on our Standard Cost

• Assisting the team with various analysis, modelling and controlling activities

In this role, you will gain hands-on experience with financial controlling and data-driven decision-making in an international company. You will develop strong analytical and stakeholder management skills while working closely with experienced colleagues on real business challenges.

Meet your future team

You will join our Finance Business Partnering team of 9 colleagues, who act as the primary Finance stakeholders for each Division and Functional Area across Kamstrup. Our focus is to ensure the highest quality of business reporting, which in turn allows us to use the data for problem solving to create real value for the company. Our team is offered a lot of responsibility, which in turn means that we set the bar high for ourselves and the results that we produce. Despite this, we have an informal atmosphere in the team, where inputs and perspectives from all team members are highly valued.

Did you know? Our team is quite diverse in terms of personality types, making collaboration in the team, and the solutions we produce, much more dynamic.

Less about us, more about you

We are looking for an enthusiastic and ambitious student who is eager to apply their knowledge of finance and business controlling while making a real impact on our team. You take pride in your work and have a great overview and structured approach, ensuring that your deadlines are met with a high degree of quality.

In order to succeed, we imagine that you:

• Are studying a degree in Economics, Business Administration, or another relevant field

• Are curious and enjoy proactively seeking new challenges where you can gain knowledge and new perspectives

• Have a structured approach to your work and thrive in managing your tasks efficiently and effectively

• Enjoy collaboration and have good communication skills, enabling you to interact and build relationships within and outside of Kamstrup

• Are well acquainted with Excel and other MS office tools

As we are an international organization it is important that you are fluent in English.

Whilst you may not meet all the qualifications listed above, you could still be a good candidate for the position. If you find the role intriguing, do not hesitate to apply.

We are more than an ordinary workplace

We offer a challenging student job in an international company where you are given independent responsibility for specific assignments, and where you can transform your theoretical knowledge into practical experience. As a student worker, you will be treated as an integrated part of the team, equal to other employees, ensuring a steep learning curve.

Besides the best colleagues you could imagine, we also offer:

• Work-life balance through flexible working hours

• Employee benefits including a healthy canteen, fitness facilities, in-house dental clinic, hairdresser, and a free health clinic

• An active employee association that fosters a collaborative and supportive workplace community

Are you a design or verification engineer with ASIC/FPGA skills, and do you have a flair for client communication? If so, then SyoSil has a great career opportunity for you.

SyoSil will soon initiate a new project, for which we search for new team members to join our existing staff of 20 highly qualified ASIC engineers. We both look for seniors as well as newly graduated engineers.

The project will focus on digital design and verification for an RF radio ASIC, being part of a large international multi-team project. In this project, SyoSil will assume the full responsibility of several IP blocks, from architecture definition towards RTL design and coverage driven verification closure. Design and verification will be done using SystemVerilog and UVM. The project management will be SCRUM based.

We offer:

• A challenging role where you work closely with a highly skilled team as well as interfacing to engineers in leading international companies

• Access to the latest technologies and ongoing professional development, including training with ASIC tools from the top EDA vendors in the SyoSil partnership portfolio

• A competitive salary and a flexible working environment

SyoSil is a market leader in the ASIC R&D space, including RTL design/verification, device firmware and tool development. Our clients include top European and U.S. semiconductor companies working in specialized fields, such as the automotive, surveillance and telecommunication industries.

**Join an international team of specialists

**

You will join a young and dynamic team of 20 engineers in a vibrant international environment close to central Copenhagen, Denmark. Contributing to large-scale project execution, you will collaborate closely with experienced and highly skilled colleagues who are all specialists within their field, giving you a unique opportunity to learn and grow.

**Take part in large-scale project execution

**

As an ASIC/FPGA design and verification engineer, you will contribute to execution of projects on a large industrial scale, from concept and specification through RTL design to verification based on coverage closure. You will also deliver turn-key verification flows, verification IP and lead projects based on established and upcoming industry standards (SystemVerilog/UVM), helping clients improve their design and verification methodologies.

In relation to this, you can look forward to some international travel to liaise with clients and project execution.

**The ideal candidate

**

Experience from the industry is a plus, but not essential. What matters most is that you are skilled within ASIC/FPGA design, thoroughly systematic in your work and know how to solve parallel problems simultaneously. Furthermore, you need to have good communication and presentation skills, enabling you to establish and develop strong client relations. In addition:

• You have a B.Sc. or an M.Sc. in electrical engineering or computer science, and you know how to debug complex systems in a traditional ASIC/FPGA design simulation environment.

• You have solid skills within RTL module design (Verilog/VHDL), and/or experience in verification using constrained random verification methodologies, (SystemVerilog/UVM).

• It is a strong plus if you are familiar with digital signal processing / filter design.

• It is also an advantage if you are familiar with C++ or Python and able to debug complex software systems in a traditional Linux-based software environment.

• You speak and write English fluently, and preferably Danish too.

If you recently graduated with very good results we strongly encourage you to apply for this position, as we are open towards investing in training you for the position.

Interested?

If you have any questions regarding the position, you are welcome to contact Peter Jensen at peter@syosil.com.

Are you passionate about finding new drug opportunities? Do you love understanding disease biology to guide the best possible drug design? Are you a seasoned professional and looking for the next step?

Ascendis Pharma is a global biopharmaceutical company committed to making a meaningful difference in patients’ lives. About the job

Flatpay has become one of Europe's fastest-growing payment companies by helping merchants accept card payments in-store.

Our Point of Sale system serves as the central engine of the business. It streamlines the merchant's entire workflow — from order taking, product and inventory management, to payment processing, reporting, and compliance.

Some of the core capabilities include:

• Product catalogue: Organizes how they manage their products, categories, modifiers and inventory

• Order management: Basket, pricing, discounts, payments and managing tables and long-running orders among groups of customers.

• Hardware integrations to barcode scanners, receipt and kitchen/bar printers and our different Mobile-, Premium- and Basic POS devices. No least manage synchronicity across multiple POS systems at shared locations in realtime.

• Our reporting suite ensures cash management, end-of-day reports, various sales, turnover, staff, tax and compliance reports that enables merchants to optimize their business and comply with local tax regulations.

As our merchants grow, so does the platform. Every new market introduces new payment methods, fiscal requirements and merchant needs. Every new feature increases the depth and complexity of the product. And with our customer base doubling approximately every six months, the demands on scalability, reliability and performance continue to grow.

This is a hands-on engineering role with significant ownership. You'll influence technical direction, contribute to architectural decisions and solve the engineering challenges that come with building one of Europe's fastest-growing commerce platforms.

You'll work closely with Product, Design and fellow engineers to build software that scales across all dimensions: more merchants, more markets, more capabilities and increasingly sophisticated workflows.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Designing, building and evolving features across our Point of Sale platform platform.

• Build and maintain features in the Android POS platform in Kotlin/Compose that connects to printers, payment terminals and utilizes real–time communication via AWS MQTT.

• Take ownership of features from design and implementation through deployment and maintenance

• Drive architectural decisions and long-term technical improvements

• Improve reliability, observability, performance, and security across the platform

• Continuously improving our engineering practices, tooling and development experience

• Contribute to testing, operational excellence and contribute to a collaborative team culture

We're looking for experienced engineers who enjoy solving difficult problems and helping others succeed.

You likely bring:

• Experience designing and operating distributed systems

• Comfortable working with modern software engineering practices, including testing and version control

• Curious, pragmatic, and eager to learn new technologies

• Strong communication skills and a willingness to take ownership of your work
